## Description

Dues list with patient, reason, amount, age (days, colour + text by bucket), statement PDF per patient (debits/credits), reminder message "You have a pending balance with {clinic}. Pay securely: link" (no clinical details).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Ageing buckets (0–30, 31–60, 61–90, 90+) are correct and filterable.
- [ ] **AC2.** Statements reconcile to invoices/payments exactly.
- [ ] **AC3.** Reminders respect channel consent and contain no clinical information.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
